title: Stack
description: Flex layout primitives (Stack, HStack, VStack) with token-based gaps, optional separators and attached groups. Children are not wrapped in item elements.

support.notes: Native view layouts, token-aware Box background/radius/shadow and numeric size resolution, spacing and attached controls, container-measured responsive grids/SplitLayout, sections/actions, compact/expanded/floating AppShell navigation and mobile drawer with route-change dismissal. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. CSS as/asChild polymorphism is not native. Floating AppShell expands by touch rather than hover. Measurements initially use window width until the native selector query returns. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

vars.name: --stack-gap

translationResources.title: Stack
translationResources.description: Flex layout primitives (Stack, HStack, VStack) with token-based gaps, optional separators and attached groups. Children are not wrapped in item elements.

basic.title: Vertical stack
basic.description: VStack stacks children in a column and stretches them by default.

horizontal.title: Horizontal stack
horizontal.description: HStack centers items on the cross axis; justify distributes them.

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: Numbers select spacing tokens (2 = 8px, 4 = 16px, 6 = 24px); other strings are CSS lengths.

wrap.title: Wrap and semantics
wrap.description: wrap lets items flow onto new lines; as renders a list.

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: separator is rendered between items, such as a vertical Divider; empty children get none.

attached.title: Attached group
attached.description: attached joins items into one group with shared borders and outer corners only, like a segmented control.

StackProps.gap: Gap between items: numbers and numeric strings select spacing tokens, other strings are CSS values. No gap when omitted.
StackProps.separator: Rendered between every two items (not before the first or after the last); empty children get no separator
StackProps.attached: Joins the items into one attached group: no gap, shared borders, outer-only corner radii and role="group"

cssVars.--stack-gap: Space between the children when the gap prop is not set (default: 0)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A column of items with a token-based gap (gap="3" is var(--space-3)). Children are slotted as-is, not wrapped.

hstack-vstack.title: HStack, VStack and alignment
hstack-vstack.description: <minerva-hstack> is a row centered on the cross axis, <minerva-vstack> a stretched column; align, justify and direction (including the reverse directions) fine-tune them.

wrap-separator.title: Separators and wrapping
wrap-separator.description: separator inserts a text between items, or, set as a JS property, a function returning fresh content per gap (here a vertical divider). wrap lets the items flow onto several lines. Separators use manual slot assignment; in browsers without slot.assign() (Safari < 16.4) the stack falls back to named slots (a slot="minerva-stack-item-n" attribute on each element child while a separator is set), so separators still appear between element children (wrap bare text in an element).

attached.title: Attached groups
attached.description: attached joins the items into one group (no gap, shared borders) exposed as role="group"; name it with aria-label.

slots.default: Items, laid out in a row.
Items, laid out in a column.
